title: Comparative Anatomy and Evolutionary Relationships Review Test
description: Spaced review for compare body structures and development patterns to evaluate evidence for evolutionary relationships.

questions.prompt: A wing and flipper share similar bones but different jobs. What does this show?
questions.questionText: A wing and flipper share similar bones but different jobs. What does this show?
options: different jobs always mean no relationship
same underlying pattern can have different functions
questions.correctAnswer: same underlying pattern can have different functions
questions.explanation: Same pattern, different job is the anchor.

questions.prompt: Why is function alone not enough?
questions.questionText: Why is function alone not enough?
options: Different structures can perform similar functions.

questions.prompt: How can fossils help comparative anatomy?
questions.questionText: How can fossils help comparative anatomy?
options: They show structure evidence from organisms that lived in the past.
They make all modern organisms identical.
